description_en: Queries task statistics in the task center
description_zh: 查询任务中心的任务统计
name: DescribeHistoryTasksStat

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the pending events. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 待处理事件所属的地域 ID，您可以通过调用 DescribeRegions 接口进行查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The task status. This parameter is used to filter tasks by status. Valid values:
Scheduled: Pending execution.
Running: Running.
Succeed: Succeeded.
Failed: Failed.
Cancelling: Cancelling.
Canceled: Canceled.
Waiting: Waiting for the scheduled time.
Default value: empty. An empty value indicates that all statuses are selected. Separate multiple statuses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，用于选择对应状态的任务：
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间
默认为空，表示全选，如需选择多个状态请用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This parameter is used to query tasks with known IDs. Default value: empty. An empty value indicates that no limit is applied. Separate multiple task IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 task IDs
parameters.help_zh: 任务 ID，用于查询已知 ID 的任务。默认为空，表示不限制。如需查询多个请用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持 30 个
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum execution duration of a task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is greater than the specified value. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0. A value of 0 indicates that no limit is applied
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最小值。用于筛选任务执行耗时大于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum execution duration of a task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is less than or equal to the specified value. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0. A value of 0 indicates that no limit is applied
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最大值。用于筛选任务执行耗时不小于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: to_exec_time

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
Scheduled: Pending execution.
Running: Running.
Succeed: Succeeded.
Failed: Failed.
Cancelling: Cancelling.
Canceled: Canceled.
Waiting: Waiting for the scheduled time
